adjudication.rationale: Looking at lines 253-255 in the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts updateEvent method: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When externalCalendarId is falsy (undefined/null), the code enters the else branch and tries to find a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (which is undefined/null). This will never match any calendar, so it returns undefined. The correct logic should find the appropriate calendar from the array (like using credentialId as done in createEvent), not search for a match against an undefined value. This is a real bug that would cause update operations to fail or use wrong calendar.
